_comment: Not present in the in-game Custom Search mode list as of 2026-08-05 (Steam capture 20260805170513). EA published no changelog line for the removal, so the in-game screen is the only source; the 'Removed' row comes from data/releases.json, which is authoritative for it. The page is kept because the mode has real patch history in the log. Scope: Custom Search covers core multiplayer only, so this says nothing about REDSEC, Battle Royale, Gauntlet or Portal.
name: King of the Hill

description.text: Battle for control over multiple objectives that activate across the combat area.

_art_note: Art is the little badge the game prints beside GAME MODE on the Custom Search screen, not a scene, so it renders at icon size rather than filling the art column. Cut from the same capture as the description. No badge exists for this one: it is no longer listed on that screen, so there is nothing to capture and the tile stays pending rather than borrowing another mode's glyph.
